metadata.canonical_id_policy: stable identity nodes plus immutable revision nodes; colon-delimited canonical identifiers

rules.condition: declared function without evidence or method

rules.description: Inferred assertions must use evidence_status=absent. Model inference is not a calculated result.
Calculated is reserved for assertion_kind=derived and requires a versioned deterministic method/formula plus explicit source assertions.
Verified requires accepted sufficient evidence, applicable method, accepted human review.
Numeric probability requires calibration version and calibrated flag.
Every inferred assertion points to execution, model, prompt and consumed evidence.
Declared function without source or method must be withheld.
High ambiguity commercial name requests more evidence.
Corrections create new assertions and preserve superseded assertion.
Only benchmark revisions may support classify.
Tactile value cannot rely only on image evidence.
Every specialized value is referenced by an assertion.

evidence_status_semantics.absent: No evidence status is conferred to the assertion. For model-produced visual classifications, the image is consumed by an Execution, but the inferred assertion remains evidence_status=absent.
evidence_status_semantics.declared: A source has declared the value, without a preserved artifact sufficient to document the declaration.
evidence_status_semantics.calculated: A deterministic and reproducible result derived from prior assertions, with a versioned method or formula and explicit input assertion identifiers. Reserved for assertion_kind=derived.
evidence_status_semantics.documented: A preserved artifact supports that an observation or declaration occurred. The artifact documents the observation; it does not by itself verify the textile property.
evidence_status_semantics.verified: The assertion passed applicable method, accepted sufficient evidence and accepted human review. File hash integrity alone never implies verification of content.
